+function makeAudio(){const sr=44100,len=DUR*sr,buf=Buffer.alloc(len*2);const notes=[261.6,329.6,392,523.3,392,329.6,440,523.3];for(let i=0;i<len;i++){const t=i/sr;const bar=Math.floor(t/1.5)%notes.length;const f=notes[bar];let s=0.18*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*f*t)*Math.exp(-((t%1.5))*0.7)+0.10*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*f/2*t)+0.06*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*notes[(bar+2)%notes.length]*t)*Math.exp(-((t%0.75))*1.2);const fade=Math.min(1,t/1,(DUR-t)/2);const v=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,s*fade));buf.writeInt16LE(v*32767,i*2)}fs.writeFileSync('music.wav',Buffer.concat([wavHeader(sr,len),buf]))}
